'''Lantillian ShipWrights''' was a corporation from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lantillies/Legends|Lantillies]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It worked in close relation with the [[Lantillian Spacers' Brotherhood/Legends|Lantillian Spacers' Brotherhood]].

Lantillian ShipWrights manufactured several types of [[Starship/Legends|starships]], one of the most famous designs was the [[GX1 short hauler/Legends|GX1 Short Hauler]], mainly designed by Project Engineer [[Shil Tervo/Legends|Shil Tervo]]. Another product was the [[Lantillian cruiser]].

Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the company was absorbed by the [[Tagge Company/Legends|Tagge Company]] and many of its designers were fired, including Tervo.
